title: DEXTRA: said out loud, confirmed in Telegram
voice: Kokoro bf_emma (British English, matches the international judging panel); speed ≤ +5%
rule: Every figure on screen is read from evidence/eval-commitments.json, the test run or the live database. No typed numbers. All footage is real: the Even simulator running the live build, Telegram Desktop, the live site.

scenes.footage: Black, then the lens frame 'listening' fades up (real capture)
scenes.voice: I'll send the deck Friday. Can you intro me to Sara? Most promises are spoken, and most of them are never written down.
scenes.notes: Open on the eval recording's actual audio for the first line, then the narrator.

scenes.footage: Live site, 'Try to slip a promise past it': the Invented money preset, then the red REFUSED stamp
scenes.voice: An AI listening to a conversation can invent a promise. In DEXTRA the AI only proposes. If the words aren't in what was actually said, it never reaches your glasses.
scenes.notes: Winner rule: open with the attack being refused. Click sound on the preset, impact on the stamp.

scenes.footage: Even simulator (live build, live server): eval conversation plays into the mic; Long Press; 'Locking what was said…'; the agreement card with one line per commitment and its date
scenes.voice: DEXTRA runs on Even G2. It keeps the last forty-five seconds in phone memory only. Agreed something? Hold the temple, and the lens shows who promised what, each line backed by their words.
scenes.notes: Caption the two speakers. Show the real Long Press input.

scenes.footage: Simulator Click → lens 'Sent to Attrito · waiting'; Telegram Desktop: the message lands in the chat, sent as the wearer by DEXTRA
scenes.voice: One tap sends it as you, into the Telegram chat you already have with them. No new app for them to install.
scenes.notes: Record only the chat pane (gdigrab offsets), mouse hidden; overlay a click ring.

scenes.footage: Second account taps the link, then Confirm ✓; lens: 'Attrito confirmed ✓ · Dictum, factum.'; the record with its SHA-256 fingerprint arrives
scenes.voice: Nothing counts until they confirm. Then you both hold the same record, sealed with a fingerprint of exactly what was agreed.
scenes.notes: Riser into impact on 'confirmed'. This is the payoff.

scenes.footage: Telegram: 'Tap each item when it's done' buttons; ☐ → ☑; the other person is told; lens updates; a real ⏰ reminder message
scenes.voice: You both tick items off. Whoever owes something gets a reminder the day before, on the day, and if it slips.
scenes.notes: Use a reminder actually sent by the live scheduler (reminders table).

scenes.footage: Site 'What we measured' block and the terminal: npm test (112 passing) and the eval summary
scenes.voice: A hundred and twelve tests pass. On twelve labelled conversations, precision is one point oh, recall point nine four, and no invented promise got through.
scenes.notes: Numbers read from evidence at build time.

scenes.footage: End card: DEXTRA · Dictum, factum. · @DextraAgreeBot · dextra-site.onrender.com · npm run try
scenes.voice: DEXTRA. Said, and done. Try it with two Telegram accounts, no glasses needed.
